notes.title: Palladium: Adventure in Greece is now in the Steam store
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Yesterday, we finally released the game we've been working on for the last two years. This is a great event for our small team.
Palladium is a first-person 3D quest where you play as an archaeologist who explores an ancient labyrinth. He will have to solve riddles based on myths of ancient Greece. He can do so alone or take one of two possible companions. Each companion has his unique way of solving riddles, so if you finish the game with one companion, you can play again with another.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137270/Palladium_Adventure_in_Greece/

To celebrate the release of the game, we decided to make a sale of all our previous games, making the highest discounts we had ever made. The sale will take place on Steam from the 7th to 13th of June 2021. Some of our games have Steam trading cards.

We sincerely hope you will enjoy our games, and especially Palladium: Adventure in Greece!
Please share your opinion about the game on its Steam page. We appreciate all the feedback we can get!

Yours faithfully,
NLB project team

notes.title: New game topics: Birds and Geography
notes.notes:
Hello all!

We are happy to announce that two more topics for "I Know Everything" are now available!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35051086/5c496c0baa52b00ab85549a410b5a1aff1cb1e68.jpg[/img]

In the Birds topic you'll test your knowledge of various birds. In certain questions you'll need to name the specific bird by its image, another type of questions will test your knowlegde of some facts from their life.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35051086/a6f23af0bc5dd75abed91e1a1902e7278d628758.png[/img]

In the Geography topic you'll need to answer several types of questions. For example, you'll need to name the country by its borders' outline, name the capital of the country, answer the questions about the great geographical discoveries, name the longest river and so on.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35051086/c950e9986288e6278e45d43e5eae4409f8af37dc.png[/img]

Also, there are a lot of questions where you should guess the country by its flag or determine which element on the flag is hidden.

We hope that you'll like this update, have fun!

Best regards,
NLB project team

notes.title: New game topics is on the way -- will be delivered as the game update
notes.notes:
Hello all!

We want to share with you some info about our future plans for this game.
The game database was initially designed to be easily expanded, and after release we immediately started to create questions for the next two topics.

The topics that are in progress right now are:
[list]
[*] [b]Geography[/b], where you can find the questions about the countries' flags, capitals, well known rivers, lakes, and mountains, deserts and so on.
[*] [b]Birds[/b], where you hopefully can learn something new :) There will be a lot of questions with images in this category, where, for example, you should name the depicted bird.
[/list]

Of course, it is not the complete list of the planned topics, I listed only those that are in the development right now. Stay tuned!

By the way, which topic do YOU want to be added to this game? Share your thoughts in the comments, and maybe we'll add these topics too!

Wish you all the best,
NLB project team

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 + Linux support
notes.notes:
Hello all!

We have updated the game to version 1.0.1. The changes are:
[list]
    [*] Added fullscreen option in the settings menu, so that you can now toggle fullscreen mode on and off.
    [*] Added auto updating of the available games list on 'Join game' screen. The game checks for available games every 20 seconds, when the game is found, it plays a sound signal.
    [*] Added flag icon to the language selection box in the start menu and increased its font size. We hope that it should increase its visibility :)
[/list]

Also, we have added the Linux versions. I tried to do my best to find out why Linux versions don't work well with Steam integration in some cases, but please note, that there can still be bugs.

Overall, singleplayer game should work fine on Linux, but you can experience problems with multiplayer and other Steam features (achievements, leaderboards). If you'll experience such problems, please, don't hesitate to create a forum post describing your problem, and I'll try to help you.

Have a nice day,
Best regards,
NLB project team

notes.title: Opensource version of 'I Know Everything'
notes.notes:
Hello all!

We have published the opensource version of 'I Know Everything': https://github.com/Antokolos/know-everything-os

The opensource version of the game differs from Steam version only in questions database (it contains only few test questions)

It can be useful for someone who uses Godot, as it contains the examples of Steam integration, localization, work with the native libraries etc.

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

Previously we planned to slightly change the release date due to some problems with the Linux build integration with Steam ecosystem, but since we've got the approval for Mac & Windows versions, we've decided to release the game for these platforms right now and add the Linux support later.

Don't worry, we'll add the Linux build as soon as we'll fix it.

Best regards,
NLB project team
